evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge, exercising positional authority to compel compliance under threat of informational loss.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Bare imperative demanding knowledge destruction, asserting authority to command erasure without justification or consultation.

mints.name: MandateKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is authority here being exercised as a direct command to destroy or suppress what is known, without offering rationale or inviting response?
